spans.s:
n. (-यं)
Abstract state, but used in composition, as ब्रह्मभूय the state of BRAHMA, or identification with BRAHMA, becoming of the same nature, &c.
E.
भू to be, aff. क्यप्.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
1 Much, many.
ind.
Frequently, repeatedly, again.
2 Exceeding, over, above.
E.
बहु much, इयसुन् affix of the superlative, भू substituted for बहु, and the ई of the aff. rejected; also with इष्ठन् aff. भूयिष्ठ.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Many, very many, much, most: see the last.
